ios.desc:
TidyCards is the no-nonsense app, designed for iPhone/iPad to manage your tasks and monitor your progress for projects big and small. Its intuitive interface makes entering and reordering tasks effortless, making it easy for you to respond to life’s ever changing challenges. Its speedy performance and offline-ready data ensure you can get work done anytime, anywhere.


STRAIGHTFORWARD ORGANISATION

- Get started quickly with familiar folders and projects layout.
- Arrange notes in easy to understand Kanban style columns.
- Locate things instantly with fast text search and filters.


STAYING IN CONTEXT

Work rarely lives in one place. Emails, files and notes tend to be scattered across different apps, folders and websites, forcing you to jump back and forth just to stay on track.
TidyCards keeps everything connected — notes can link to emails, files and more — so you always have the context you need right where you’re working.


YOU’RE IN CONTROL OF YOUR DATA

TidyCards can sync via Apple’s secure iCloud storage between Mac, iPhone and iPad. It intelligently merges texts when edited on multiple devices to avoid conflict. If needed, you can also choose to keep your data stored only on your local device to meet any workplace or policy requirements. Whichever option you choose, your data is never shared with us or any third party.


COLLABORATION AND SHARING

- Easily share your project with your team members or clients.
- Control whether others can edit or just view the projects you share.


DISCIPLINED DESIGN, SPECIALLY ENGINEERED TO EXCELLENCE

- Single window operation, edit texts directly in any note without opening additional controls.
- Group your projects into folders and even nested folders.
- Turn any lines of text into a checklist.
- Import, Export and Backup your projects for extra peace of mind.


PRO FEATURES [Upgrade Purchase Required]

- Set notification reminders on due items.
- Attach files, photos and links.
- Link emails in your iOS Mail inbox directly to your notes.
- Customise project background colour or image, including using your own photo.
- Print your projects with advanced page layout tools.


WITH YOU ANYWHERE

TidyCards is available on Mac, iPhone and iPad, all your data syncs via iCloud. Jot your idea down on the iPhone and pick back up when you’re back on your Mac.


WHY CHOOSE TIDYCARDS?

TidyCards is designed for anyone who wants a bit more than just a simple note taking app without the weight of a complex and rigid system. Ti
